name: Arclight
overview: Arclight for Jellyfin: watch-state sync, requests, status badges and watchlist from your Arclight server.
description: Connects Jellyfin to a self-hosted Arclight media manager. Forwards playback, watched, library and user events to Arclight from every Jellyfin client, and adds Arclight search results, request buttons, download/request status badges, a watchlist button, problem reports and subtitle/audio language requests to Jellyfin Web. The Arclight API key stays on the Jellyfin server.
